title: Apex Overdrive
description: An original low-poly F1-style arcade racer. Drift through three circuits, launch off ramps, chase fastest times, and survive the Vault Ring wall ride.

defaultCaptions.x: Hold the line. Find the air. Apex Overdrive is an original low-poly F1-style arcade racer with three circuits, ramps, drift boosts, and a magnetic wall ride.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Apex Overdrive: an original low-poly F1-style arcade racer. Three circuits, big jumps, drift boosts, and the Vault Ring wall ride. How fast can you lap?
defaultCaptions.reddit: I made Apex Overdrive, an original low-poly F1-style arcade racer with three circuits, jump ramps, a live timer, and a magnetic wall ride. Would love feedback on the handling and track layouts.
defaultCaptions.discord: Apex Overdrive is live: an original low-poly F1-style arcade racer with three circuits, ramps, drift boosts, and a magnetic wall ride. Set a time on the global board.
